attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "The widget creation route-value keys change from \"LayerMetadata.Zone\"/\"LayerMetadata.Position\" to \"Zone\"/\"Position\" and the model-binding prefix logic in LayerMetadataWelder is reworked, which could silently break any custom code, scripts, or third-party modules that create layer widgets using the old route-value contract."}

reason: The widget creation route-value keys change from "LayerMetadata.Zone"/"LayerMetadata.Position" to "Zone"/"Position" and the model-binding prefix logic in LayerMetadataWelder is reworked, which could silently break any custom code, scripts, or third-party modules that create layer widgets using the old route-value contract.
